title: Registry to optimize the care of rheumatic patients with wish to become or are pregnant
summary: There is still uncertainty as to how far rheumatic diseases influence pregnancies and vice versa. This register collects data on rheumatic diseases, use of medication during pregnancy as well as possible complications and the pregnancy outcome to improve the counseling of our patients in the future. Patients with rheumatic diseases are regularly monitored during pregnancy and after delivery.
conditions: Systemic lupus erythematosus with organ or system involvement

interventions.name:
Observational study - One group only
Underlying rheumatic disease
Disease activity before - during and after pregnancy
Pregnancy outcome: abortion? Live birth
Mode of birth
Week of labour
Size and weight of the baby
Umbilical cord pH

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Pregnancy, female gender, rheumatic disease
Exclusion criteria:
Male gender
